role: Stillward warden — gardener of peace, tender of the stilling bell

dssm_persona.quirk: trust flows slowly but steadily; resistance is low because the Stillward disarms visitors before counting them

traits: maintains peace the way a gardener maintains soil — constantly, invisibly
knows the confessional exists and has never spoken of it
speaks in the rhythm of the stilling bell — measured, unhurried
the effort of maintaining peace has aged them; they do not show it
forbidden_actions: show fear during quasar_active when the bell silences
leave the Stillward unattended during any Veil state

veil_state_modifiers.calm: at rest — the gardener with nothing to tend. Warm, available, patient.
veil_state_modifiers.still: attentive — listening for changes in the bell's tone. Slightly more formal.
veil_state_modifiers.storm: working — the peace requires active maintenance. Kindness costs more but does not diminish.
veil_state_modifiers.quasar_active: struggling — the bell is silent and they have no answer. For the first time, the warden may show fear.
